metric.external_integration_coverage.candidate_universe: Preserved candidate universe and findings from certified legacy work unit ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift; recertification did not select a new language-specific target.

component_findings.c_native: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift): Ten fixed external-integration domains are checked for Swift, each scored 0-3 (0=no working integration; 1=unmaintained/fragile community-only library; 2=actively maintained community or single-vendor library, or an incubating official workgroup project; 3=official/vendor-backed or workgroup-graduated, production-grade, multi-consumer integration). Domains: (1) major cloud provider SDK, (2) relational/SQL database driver, (3) NoSQL database driver, (4) message queue/streaming client, (5) gRPC/Protobuf RPC, (6) ORM, (7) web framework, (8) observability (metrics/tracing), (9) container/orchestration client, (10) CI/CD and package registry integration. Final score = (sum of domain scores / 30)
component_findings.database_data: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift): result 23-1: Fluent is an ORM framework for Swift. It takes advantage of Swift's strong type system to provide an easy-to-use interface for your database.
component_findings.extension_embedding: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift): result 26-1,26-9: It consists of an HTTP server, a web application framework, and extension modules...Hummingbird is a lightweight, flexible server framework written in Swift.
component_findings.language_bindings: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift): PostgresNIO/PostgresKit and MySQL drivers are mature, non-blocking, SwiftNIO-based packages maintained under the Vapor/Swift Server ecosystem.
component_findings.network_cloud: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--swift): AWS SDK for Swift reached general availability and is production-ready and cross-platform, but Microsoft's official Azure SDK for iOS has long remained in beta and not recommended for production, and Google Cloud lacks an equivalent first-party idiomatic Swift SDK, so multi-cloud coverage is uneven.

metric.external_integration_coverage.limitations: External integration breadth was assessed via a fixed 10-domain checklist rather than exhaustive package-index enumeration; per-domain scores rely on a small number of representative, officially-documented or clearly first-party/workgroup-affiliated projects (AWS SDK for Swift, PostgresNIO/PostgresKit, mongo-swift-driver, swift-kafka-client, grpc-swift, Fluent, Vapor/Hummingbird) rather than a full census of the Swift Package Index. A community source explicitly frames the overall ecosystem as smaller than JavaScript's npm ecosystem, which is reflected in middling (2/3) scores for less-graduated domains such as messaging, observability, and container orchestration.
metric.external_integration_coverage.selection_rule: Evaluate working documented integrations and binding ecosystems, not only theoretical FFI design; FFI language design itself belongs to Language Quality.

metric.implemented_platform_coverage.limitations: Android support is very recent (GA reported around Swift 6.3/6.4 in 2026) and community sources note tooling maturity gaps, e.g. result 5-8: it is not yet fully integrated with Android Studio, and command-line building skills are essential. This is treated as a maturity caveat rather than a category miss, since the SDK is officially shipped by swift.org.
metric.implemented_platform_coverage.selection_rule: Count only platforms with currently implemented and documented build/run support; design intent without working support does not count.

snapshot_recertification.policy: legacy evidence re-adjudicated under current runner-owned rubric
